json_schema.title: PR-REVIEW-SKILL-002 v2 §3.E — the structured output agy is asked for
json_schema.$comment: NOT under schemas/. That directory is VENDORED UPSTREAM artifacts only — two files, a SHA-256 manifest and a sources.json recording where each came from, enforced by scripts/check_vendored_schemas.sh and its own mutation guard. This schema is authored here, has no upstream, and would have no honest row in sources.json; putting it there would make a provenance record that records nothing. It is the skill's own output contract, so it lives with the skill.

reviewed.description: false means agy declined or could not review. The caller records status: unreachable and verdict DEGRADED — never a run that found nothing.

findings.description: May be empty. An empty array under reviewed:true is 'ran and found nothing', which is a different artifact from 'could not run' (§3.0).

grounding.description: §1's three marks and there is no fourth. A `measured` finding here was measured by AGY's process, not the primary reviewer's — the receipt records that in reverified_by_primary (§3.E.5).

failure_scenario.description: §4.2: a finding that cannot name the concrete failure it permits is a comment, not a finding.

source.description: Required by the guard when grounding is `cited`: a citation with no source is an assertion wearing the mark of a citation (§1.1).

command.description: argv, when grounding is `measured`. It records what AGY ran, and the primary reviewer does not re-run it (§3.E.5).
